title: Oven-Roasted Jamaican Pork Tagine
description: A flavorful and tender Jamaican-inspired dish featuring pork, onions, and spices roasted to perfection in the oven. This recipe is free from added sugars and is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the pork from the pot and set it aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the chopped onion to the pot.
Cook the onion until it's softened and lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the diced scotch bonnet peppers, allspice, thyme, and ginger to the pot.
Add the soy sauce to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the pork shoulder to the pot and make sure it's coated with the spice mixture.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast the pork for 2-3 hours, or until it's tender and falls apart easily.
Let the pork rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing it thinly and serving it with the sauce from the pot.
